target.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core
target.body:
## Summary

- add immutable, create-only JSONL action shards with deterministic replay and conflict detection
- correlate every event by logical operation, execution attempt, parent event, phase sequence, and retry-stable idempotency key
- define the complete six-family taxonomy:
  1. review, including batch, item, retry, review-log publication, and review-comment publication
  2. command receive, classify, claim refresh, progress, wait, requeue, and recovery
  3. repair intake through dispatch, plan, execute, validate, review, publish, post-flight, queue, requeue, recovery, blocked, and failed
  4. apply action, batch, and publication phases
  5. workflow, dispatch, retry, queue, notification, publication, status, dashboard, session, cancellation, and projection lifecycles
  6. Gitcrawl snapshot, query, binding, proof-stage, and proof-binding evidence
- enforce privacy bounds that reject raw prompts, comments, diffs, logs, credentials, private paths, and arbitrary payload fields
- provide workflow runtime helpers, CrabFleet live projection, durable projection-failure events, state-shard import, and a checked-in JSON schema

## Design

- local writers spool one immutable event file per transition
- workflow finalization batches events into one digest-addressed shard per producer job
- retries preserve logical operation and external mutation identity while receiving distinct attempt and event identities
- mutable comments, dashboards, sessions, command ledgers, and evidence graphs remain projections, not the source of truth
- this PR establishes the schema and runtime only; lane instrumentation follows in smaller reviewable PRs

## Validation

- `oxfmt --check` on all changed files
- `oxlint` on source and tests
- `tsc -p tsconfig.json`
- `node --test test/action-ledger.test.ts test/action-ledger-runtime.test.ts` (`39/39`)
- checked-in JSON schema parses successfully

## Follow-ups

- instrument review/apply and sweep publication
- instrument command, repair, notification, and operational workflows
- bind review and closure evidence to Gitcrawl snapshots and Cloudflare archive queries
- add deterministic projection rebuilds and retention compaction
